title: Campus SOC Similar Threat Verdict
goal: Analyze a prepared packet-feature workbook from a campus traffic capture, apply the exact port-scan, DoS, and beaconing thresholds, and write the final threat verdict plus supporting metrics to /root/campus_verdict.json.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source task’s core workflow of network threat triage, but shifts from full metric extraction to threshold-driven judgment so threat-detection is the only critical shipped skill.
